message.content: The case concerns whether the buyer can close its pre-award eligibility check for Vale's bid in the Silver Acre district. The prior assessment found that Vale did not submit a bid on lot 3, as the tender portal shows a bid only on lot 2, contradicting claim A. Claim C, that the bid was submitted before the deadline, is supported by a timestamped portal record showing submission 42 minutes early. Claim B, regarding Vale holding the required liability policy on 1 July, remains unresolved because the only evidence is a draft quote conditional on payment, lacking binding proof of coverage. Thus, the key issue is the unresolved insurance status, while the lot bid and timing claims are settled.
